# OSC 7501 is parsed by the library; root records reach OnAgent with its names
size 80 24
write "\x1b]7501;state=working\x1b\\"
expect agent "working" ""
write "\x1b]7501;state=blocked:kind=permission:app=claude-code\x07"
expect agent "blocked" "permission"
write "\x1b]7501;state=done:id=sub/1\x1b\\"
expect agent "" ""
write "\x1b]7501;state=idle\x1b\\"
expect agent "idle" ""
